summary: Keep reconciliation controls responsive while runtime starts are blocked

replay.detail: Existing graph projections require no replay. Opening the upgraded local store creates an empty launch-operation ledger; subsequent launches retain immutable request and result bindings. Unresolved operations survive daemon restarts and are never automatically replayed.

schema.detail: Local SQLite storage advances from 18 to 19, adding runtime-start operation and evidence tables plus admission indexes. Both stores use one shared storage-version constant. Unresolved local request/result evidence is pinned against trimming. Existing version-18 stores migrate additively on open; older binaries reject version 19. Resolved ledger rows are retained, including their prepared launch body; disk usage currently grows with launch count and requires capacity planning until a separate reviewed retention policy is added. Installation atomically captures immutable shared/local publication format cuts with two indexed maxima before any operation-bound request; reopening, replay and forgetting preserve them. Resolved evidence pins are released, so original local observation bodies may later trim while ledger bindings and result proof remain retained.

rules.detail: Replicated claim kinds, checkpoint rules and rule digests are unchanged; the operation ledger is local state.

compatibility.detail: Agent detail responses add pending-operation, running/revoked-running and unresolved/revoked-unresolved fields; agents show displays START, START JOBS and START OPEN. Native exec generation records retain an optional launch-operation identifier. Existing PTY tags carry the operation. Returned launches with missing or mismatched operation/incarnation evidence remain Unknown and retain admission until exact verification or positive producer closure. Strict prevention of late PTY publication requires the separately reviewed producer cancellation contract.

downtime.detail: Normal deployment still requires daemon restart. The additive local migration has fixture coverage, but restart-to-API and restart-to-health times have not been measured on installation-sized stores.

manual.detail: Inspect START OPEN after upgrade when a start was interrupted or revoked. Do not clear the ledger to force a retry; only exact verification, positive producer closure or operation-owned retirement releases admission.

recovery.detail: Preserve the version-19 database and roll forward. Older binaries reject the upgraded header; downgrading it does not undo the migration. Database swap-back requires a consistent pre-upgrade snapshot and compatible binary, subject to the separately classified runtime-state restoration prerequisites. A used ledger missing either immutable format cut is refused; preserve its store and original boundary evidence for forward recovery instead of capturing a later cut. Unreleased earlier version-19 PR-head stores are not supported upgrade sources for this boundary.
